title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 49 (Place for performance of promise, where no application to be made and no place fixed for performance)

content.overview: Section 49 provides that when a promise is to be performed without application by the promisee, and no place is fixed for the performance of it, it is the duty of the promisor to apply to the promisee to appoint a reasonable place for the performance of the promise, and to perform it at such place.
content.glance: No application needed, no place fixed → promisor must apply to promisee to appoint a reasonable place and perform there.
content.study: Where the promisor is to perform without application by the promisee and no place is fixed, the promisor must apply to the promisee to appoint a reasonable place and perform at that place. Current-law framing: confirm no application and no fixed place; apply promisor’s duty to seek appointment of a reasonable place and perform there.

sections.heading: Duty to seek appointment of place
sections.body: Promisor must apply to the promisee to appoint a reasonable place for performance and perform at such place.

provisions.title: Place for performance of promise, where no application to be made and no place fixed for performance

examples.title: No place fixed
examples.body: A is to deliver goods to B without B applying and with no place fixed. A must apply to B to appoint a reasonable place and deliver there under s. 49.

hypotheticals.question: Who chooses the place when none is fixed?
hypotheticals.analysis: The promisor must apply to the promisee to appoint a reasonable place under s. 49.

misconceptions.trap: The promisor may choose any place when none is fixed.
misconceptions.correction: Section 49 requires the promisor to apply to the promisee to appoint a reasonable place.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 49 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Confirm no application and no fixed place. II. Apply promisor’s duty to seek appointment of a reasonable place. III. Conclude performance at that place.

examTips: State the promisor’s duty to apply for appointment of a reasonable place.
